mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST (both down > 1% from prior month) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (when the Fed is raising rates), a federal funds rate above 1.0% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, the federal funds rate above 1.0% fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the non-farm payrolls level exceeds 140,000 thousand, strong job growth boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 140,000 thousand, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1000 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment expansion (UNRATE < 4.5% and declining), sustained labor market strength drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In low unemployment expansion regimes (UNRATE < 4.5% and declining), the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
